_note: MASSALIA crafts its two hulls at the Shipbuilder's slipway (buildings.json craft); here at the Shipyard, which only a coastal town with a Harbor may raise. Naval supplies (a slipway yield in MASSALIA), remedies and poisons (agora goods in MASSALIA) are crafted here as EMPORION's own recipes: supplies at the Shipyard, remedies and poisons at the hetaira's Salon. Resources are a town's stores; goods are the house's. People named under 'people' are busy while the job runs. Holdings yield as MASSALIA's buildings do: base × 1.8^(level − 1), times the season's production factor (buildings.json seasonal.coefficients). The altar stands in the Sanctuary and needs a priest.
